The `AuthClient` object response can be used for the `Intuit UserInfo API <https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization/openid-connect#obtaining-user-profile-information>`_, `QuickBooks Accounting API <https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api>`_, and `QuickBooks Payments API <https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbpayments/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-payments-api>`_.
